# FastYoke

## About FastYoke

- [FastYoke — The Open-Architecture aPaaS](https://www.fastyoke.io/): Build at the speed of low-code, perform at the speed of the edge, leave whenever you want. Multi-tenant FSM platform for ISVs who refuse vendor lock-in.
- [Pricing — FastYoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/pricing): Simple pricing that scales from a side project to a regulated fleet. Free with every Vercel Marketplace install; paid tiers on request.
- [Privacy Notice — FastYoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/privacy): How FastYoke handles personal data submitted through public forms, account info, and product telemetry. Plain-language summary plus the data subject's rights.
- [Free Online Form Builder — FastYoke Solo Plan](https://www.fastyoke.io/free-forms): Build unlimited forms for free. Drag-and-drop builder, multi-page flows, conditional logic, themes, and PDF generation. Designed for personal projects and small businesses.
- [Terms of Service — FastYoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/terms): The terms governing your use of FastYoke — eligibility, accounts, acceptable use, SMS messaging consent, billing, and the standard disclaimers and liability limits.
- [SMS Opt-In — FastYoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/sms-opt-in): How FastYoke users opt in to receive transactional SMS messages, with screenshots of the in-product consent screen and the seven required disclosures.
- [Security Fixes — FastYoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/security-fixes): Known security findings and their fix status across FastYoke releases.
- [Channel Partners & ISVs — FastYoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/channel-partners): Early access program for systems integrators, channel partners, and independent software vendors building on the FastYoke aPaaS.
- [Yoke Architect — A Thesis](https://www.fastyoke.io/yoke-architect)

## Documentation

- [Deprecation Policy](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/deprecation-policy): What a deprecated surface means, when it goes away, and how to migrate.
- [FastYoke Docs](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs): The aPaaS for logistics. Multi-tenant FSMs, schema-driven entities, extensible admin surfaces.

## Accessibility

- [Accessibility](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/accessibility): WCAG 2.1 AA enforced in CI, theme contrast validated on save, focus-trap modal primitive — the architectural pieces that clear institutional procurement.

## Apps

- [Advanced App Builder](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/advanced): Enterprise / ISV SPA-delivery surface — artifacts, health, handoff zip, and the Studio wizard / LLM-authored extension generators.
- [Simple Project Tracker](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/simple-project-tracker): Free marketplace app — organize projects, tasks, and comments with a Kanban board.
- [Studio wizard](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/studio-wizard): Wix-style 4-step builder — pick a layout, brand it, choose entities, ship a themed multi-page extension.
- [Inventory Yoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/inventory-yoke)
- [Vendara Payments](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/vendara-payments): Connect your Vendara account to invoice customers from your CRM orders and quotes.
- [Apps](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps): Group pages under a shared slug + theme; the user-facing face of your tenant.
- [Dejavoo SPIn Payments](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/dejavoo-spin): Take card-present payments on your Dejavoo terminals from the parts counter and service cashier.
- [Auto Dealer Yoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/auto-dealer-yoke): Run your service drive and parts counter with integrated card-present payments.
- [Compliance Yoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/compliance): Continuous control monitoring and audit readiness — SOC 2 first, framework-agnostic.
- [Cross-App Connections](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/cross-app-bridge)
- [EHR / ADT Connector](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/ehr-connector)
- [Patient Flow Yoke](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/patient-flow)
- [Urgent Care Triage](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/apps/urgent-care)

## Forms

- [Forms Builder](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/builder): Pages, sections, field types, routing, themes, attachments.
- [Recipes](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes): Short, isolated single-task pages for experienced builders.
- [Tutorials](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials): Guided 101 → 201 → 301 path that builds one clinic Patient Intake form across every Forms Builder feature.
- [Forms](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms): Build public or authenticated forms that route submissions into entities, jobs, or both.
- [Required email with confirmation copy](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/required-email-with-confirmation): Force an email field, surface a clear "we'll email you" line so the submitter knows what's coming.
- [Build your first form](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/101-build-first-form): Create the Patient Intake form — two pages, six fields, publish.
- [Skip a page when a checkbox is unchecked](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/skip-page-on-checkbox): Use a routing rule to bypass a page based on a boolean.
- [Style and brand your form](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/101-style-and-brand): Apply a theme, upload a logo and hero, customize the header and submit-button copy.
- [Make a field effectively required only on a later page](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/conditional-required-by-page): Keep a field optional early, then use a routing rule to block navigation past a later page until it's filled.
- [Share with an invite or embed](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/101-share-invite-and-embed): Mint a kiosk invite link and embed the form on your marketing site.
- [Rename the downloaded PDF per submission](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/rename-pdf-per-submission): Set a vanity filename pattern once; every submission's download link uses it.
- [Forms tier entitlements](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tiers): What each tier unlocks for the Forms surface — active form count, daily submission ceiling, anti-abuse posture, PDF rendering, badge visibility.
- [Attach an AcroForm template](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/201-acroform-template): Upload a fillable PDF, map form fields to AcroForm fields, render on submit.
- [Embed a form on a Next.js page](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/embed-on-nextjs): Drop the embed snippet onto any page; works in App Router and Pages Router.
- [Place an Overlay template](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/201-overlay-template): Drop value regions onto any PDF — works on scans, no AcroForm needed.
- [Mint a one-shot invite link](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/mint-one-shot-invite): Single-use, expires when consumed — perfect for a personal email.
- [Collect signatures](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/201-signatures): Add a signature field and wire it into both your AcroForm and your Overlay template.
- [Switch a form's theme without rebuilding](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/switch-theme-without-rebuild): Theme change is a single save — no need to re-author the form.
- [Promote submissions into entity records](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/201-promote-to-entity): Spawn a job per submission, then fire a transition that copies the submission into a Patient record.
- [Add a signature line to an AcroForm template](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/add-signature-to-acroform): Bind a signature field to a PDF widget — same captured image flows in.
- [Prefill fields from your entity schema](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/201-entity-prefill): Annotate the patient entity once; the form's labels, requireds, and select options come along automatically.
- [Test a form locally with the HTTP ingestion API](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/local-test-via-http-ingestion): Skip the UI — POST a payload directly to verify your wiring.
- [Conditional routing](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/301-conditional-routing): Skip the insurance page for minors — simple mode first, then the same rule in JSONLogic.
- [Reset Turnstile when you're locked out in dev](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/recipes/reset-turnstile-in-dev): One admin action clears the per-tenant counters.
- [File uploads and scanning](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/301-file-uploads-and-scanning): Collect insurance card images; watch them flow through the three-layer scanner.
- [Anti-abuse tuning](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/301-anti-abuse): Turnstile, honeypot, daily cap — what each catches and how to reset when you're locked out in dev.
- [Custom CSS](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/301-custom-css): Wire your brand's exact hex tokens with per-form CSS — Enterprise / ISV only.
- [Server-to-server submission](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/301-http-ingestion): Pipe an upstream scheduler's POSTs into the form via the HTTP ingestion API.
- [Vanity PDF filenames](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/tutorials/301-vanity-filenames): Replace the default `submission-<id>.pdf` with a readable per-submission filename.
- [Embed forms on your own site](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/embed): Drop a single script tag into any page to render a FastYoke form inline, with theme overrides and origin allowlists.
- [HTTP ingestion API](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/http-ingestion): Server-to-server submission of form data via REST. Authenticate with a tenant API token, post a JSON payload, get a submission ID back.
- [Anti-abuse for public forms](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/anti-abuse): Turnstile challenges, honeypots, daily caps, and per-IP rate limits keep public form submissions clean without a CAPTCHA wall.
- [Form invites (Mint)](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/invites): Issue named, revocable invite links to public forms. The Mint endpoint produces a URL anyone can submit; revoked invites return 410.
- [Vanity PDF filenames](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/forms/pdf-vanity-filenames): Generate human-readable filenames for submission PDFs using a pattern of slugs, submission IDs, field values, and dates.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/getting-started): Sign in, provision a tenant, build your first form, wire it to an FSM.
- [Installation](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/getting-started/installation): Sign in, confirm your tenant assignment, invite teammates.
- [Your First Form](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/getting-started/first-form): Build a public form, collect submissions, spawn jobs from them.
- [Sign up](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/getting-started/signup): Create a FastYoke tenant in under a minute — enter your email, confirm it, you're on the free Solo tier.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/integrations): Encrypted credential storage for outbound webhooks, Twilio, SendGrid, and custom REST endpoints.
- [Email Connector (Gmail & Outlook)](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/integrations/mail-connector): Sync customer emails into your CRM, automatically — connect Gmail or Outlook/M365.
- [Vercel](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/integrations/vercel): Install FastYoke from the Vercel Marketplace, or sign up directly and link an existing Vercel project. Both paths end at the same tenant.

## Jobs

- [Jobs](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/jobs): The runtime side of workflows — live FSM instances you fire transitions against.

## LCAP

- [LCAP](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/lcap): Low-Code Application Platform — annotation-driven entity rendering. One annotation row drives Forms v2, Page Designer, CRUD scaffolds, and `@fastyoke/next` SSR pages.
- [Annotations](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/lcap/annotations): Edit field annotations from `/admin/entities/:name`. Type picker cascades — changing field_type prunes invalid component slugs and config keys automatically.
- [Field types](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/lcap/field-types): The closed 9-type vocabulary every LCAP consumer resolves against. Type drives the default component; @ui/component overrides it within the type's allowed slug list.
- [Formatting](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/lcap/formatting): Currency, percent, date, and time formatting reference. Native Intl + a tiny dayjs-token parser. Storage stays canonical; locale + timezone applied at display only.
- [Page Designer integration](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/lcap/page-designer): The `entity_field` block binds a Page Designer block to one (entity, field, record) tuple and mounts `<SmartField mode="display" />`. Annotation drives display formatting — change once, every block follows.
- [UI config reference](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/lcap/ui-config): Every `@ui/*` key the resolver respects, organized by field_type. The annotation row's `ui_config_json` is the single source of truth.

## Pages

- [Pages](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/pages): Block-based workspace pages that embed FastYoke data into your operator UI.

## Recipes

- [Webhook Intake](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/recipes/webhook-intake): Receive external events as FSM-backed jobs via a public form + invite token.
- [Extension Authoring](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/recipes/extension-authoring): End-to-end — scaffold, iterate locally, publish to a tenant.
- [CI Scripting](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/recipes/ci-scripting): Automate tenant-scoped operations from CI using a long-lived FastYoke API token + curl.
- [CRUD UI with the SDK Hooks](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/recipes/sdk-crud-ui): Full list + create + update + delete page for a user-defined entity kind using @fastyoke/sdk 0.2.0.
- [SPA on Cloudflare Pages with the React SDK](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/recipes/spa-on-cloudflare-pages): Build a standalone Vite + React SPA that signs in to FastYoke, CRUDs entities with realtime, uploads files, and deploys to Cloudflare Pages.
- [Recipes](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/recipes): Focused walkthroughs for the common FastYoke integration patterns.
- [Handle email bounces and complaints](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/recipes/email-bounces): How FastYoke processes AWS SES bounce and complaint notifications, where the suppression list lives, and how to recover a recipient.

## SDK

- [SDK Quickstart](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/sdk/quickstart): Install @fastyoke/sdk and mount your first extension.
- [SDK Reference](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/sdk/reference): Public exports of @fastyoke/sdk — provider, data hooks, realtime client, FsmTimeline / FsmViewer, WorkflowHistory, SmartField, and the typed resource clients.
- [SDK](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/sdk): @fastyoke/sdk — build extensions, page designer blocks, and host integrations.

## Security

- [Trust Center](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/security/trust-center): How FastYoke protects your data — isolation, encryption, access control, auditability, availability, and our path to SOC 2.
- [PII / SPI Field Encryption](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/security/encryption): Tag entity-field annotations or form-field schemas with `is_pii` to encrypt their values at rest under a per-tenant key. Available as a $19/mo add-on at every tier.

## Workflows

- [FSM Designer](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/workflows/builder): Draw the graph, wire transitions, compose guards, declare actions.
- [Workflows](https://www.fastyoke.io/docs/workflows): Finite-state machines with sandboxed guards, declarative actions, and multi-version publishing.
